correctness.rationale: Derivative identity is algebraically exact on 0<x,r<1. The unique critical point has diagonal positive-definite Hessian, so regular nearby levels are periodic by the Morse lemma and nonsingular tangent flow. Offdiagonal Jacobian gives omega squared exactly mc(1-r*)/(d epsilon). The embedded symbolic checker checks 75 identities and numerical H-drift <1e-9 for a primary-source parameter set; these experiments are not substituted for proof.
